paper_metadata.title: Mechanical and functional properties of two-phase Ni53Mn22Co6Ga19 high-temperature shape memory alloy with the addition of Dy

evidence.quote: The effects of Dy addition on microstructure, martensitic transformation, mechanical and shape memory properties of the two-phase Ni53Mn22Co6Ga19 high-temperature shape memory alloy were investigated.

evidence.section: 3.3. Mechanical properties and shape memory effect
evidence.quote: Figure 7 shows the stress–strain curve for x= 0.3 at a pre-strain of 5.0%. The corresponding residual strain is 3.6% after unloading. ... The recoverable strain is 2.4%, corresponding to a recovery rate of 67%.

evidence.section: 3.3. Mechanical properties and shape memory effect
evidence.quote: The recoverable strain is 2.4%, corresponding to a recovery rate of 67%.

the (Ni53Mn22Co6Ga19)99.8Dy0.2 alloy exhibits a variety of good properties, including a high martensitic transformation starting temperature of 385.7◦C, a tensile ductility of 10.3% and a shape memory effect of 2.8%.

evidence.section: 3.3. Mechanical properties and shape memory effect
evidence.quote: It appears that the reﬁnement of grain size has a beneﬁcial effect on the tensile ductility and strength of the alloys.

evidence.section: 3.3. Mechanical properties and shape memory effect
evidence.quote: the amount of Dy(Ni, Mn)4Ga precipitates in the x= 0.3 alloy may negatively affect the beneﬁts of the γ phase on the ductility improvement, leading to a decrease in the tensile ductility and strength of the alloy at x= 0.3.
